note: Our analysis notes on reference points, kept apart from the citations (reference_sites.json is never edited to carry them). Each note names its evidence file.

reference-malapert-massif.text: Published point is on the massif's far side from Earth (0% Earth). The DEM crest 10.7 km east (85.989° S, 2.101° E, 5,169 m) sees Earth 70% and Sun 84% in Nov 2026. Try it as a clicked point.

suggested_point.label: Malapert crest (240 m DEM highest point)

reference-lola-site-001.text: Sunlight depends strongly on terrain resolution here: 69% on the 5 m site map vs 100% on the 240 m map for Jan 2027 at the same coordinates. Site panel numbers use 5 m.

reference-lola-site-004.text: The published point sits in a ~200 m pit: 0% Sun on the 5 m map in Jan 2027 while the rim 250 m away gets 86-89%. See the landing ellipse.
